Comment.value:
As of Q v2.1, the jump animation through chat command has been disabled due to an exploit that allowed PCs to jump through locked doors and walls. 

Use this waypoint with the corresponding trigger to allow a PC to use the chat command to jump from the location of the trigger in the direction of the waypoint.

When placing this waypoint you must place a corresponding jump trigger that has the same tag as the waypoint. Therefore, each waypoint and trigger should have a unique tag.
